interaction: Hover, tap or Tab through the numbered parts list to highlight each part of an exploded bike drawing with its specs, a workshop tip and the service level that covers it; 'Assemble' snaps the nine parts together with wheelbase dimensions (and back); a frame-size finder turns height + inseam into an illustrative road / MTB / hybrid size range with a live frame diagram; service-level cards feed a drop-off booking form that ends in a demo toast.
notes: Frame sizes use simple inseam rules of thumb and are labelled illustrative. Opening hours and drop-off days are computed in Canberra time.
